 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill the inside of a rectangular 3-frame with alternating square rings
    centered on its interior 3 marker (3 at distance 0, then 4/2 alternation).
    """
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marks = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    top = min(r for r, _ in marks)
    bottom = max(r for r, _ in marks)
    left = min(c for _, c in marks)
    right = max(c for _, c in marks)
    seeds = [(r, c) for r, c in marks if top < r < bottom and left < c < right]
    sr, sc = seeds[0]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            d = max(abs(r - sr), abs(c - sc))
            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 == 1 else 2)
    return out
